# Shuye Lab

> Apps and books for learning Chinese

Shuye Lab (书叶工作室) is an independent studio making apps for learning Chinese and tracking daily practice, as well as printed study books.

## Apps

- Kaihua: HSK 3.0 vocabulary with tone training (7-Day Tone Camp), spaced repetition, and character breakdowns. Available in English, Korean, and Thai. Coming soon to iOS and Android.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/apps/kaihua/

- ChiHeng: A quiet log for daily practice, helping learners track study streaks. Coming soon to iOS and Android.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/apps/chiheng/

## Books

All books are available on Amazon in paperback, hardcover, and Kindle editions.

- Grid by Grid Chinese: HSK 3.0 workbook series covering Levels 1-4, with stroke-by-stroke character practice, vocabulary exercises, and full-length practice tests.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/grid-by-grid-chinese/

- Civics in Two Languages: Bilingual study guides for the U.S. citizenship test, with large print for senior learners and free audio resources.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/civics-in-two-languages/

- Chinese Classics in Parallel Text: Original English translations of classical Chinese texts, including The Art of War with scholarly annotations.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/chinese-classics-parallel/

- Motif by Motif: Chess tactics workbooks with 500+ positions verified by Stockfish, organized by tactical themes.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/motif-by-motif-chess/
